description: HREA: High Resolution Electricity Access is a dataset listed in Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue, a cloud catalogue of environmental and geospatial data sets, published or maintained by University of Michigan. The HREA project aims to provide open access to new indicators of electricity access and reliability across the world. Leveraging satellite imagery with computational methods, these high-resolution data provide new tools to track progress toward reliable and sustainable energy access across the world. Coverage: settlement-level electricity access and reliability for parts of Latin America and the Caribbean (bounding box 117 W to 53 W, 55 S to 33 N). The catalogue entry lists assets named estimated-brightness, light-composite, lightscore, night-proportion, reachable through the STAC API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure exposure, hazard and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-planetary-computer-catalogue.
